sn18.11:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn18.11:1.3: atha kho āyasmā rāhulo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ rāhulaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn18.11:1.7: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn18.11:1.9: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn18.11:1.18: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā taṃ sukhaṃ vāti?
sn18.11:1.20: yaṃ panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, kallannu taṃ samanupassituṃ:
sn18.11:1.23: evaṃ passaṃ rāhula, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati, jivhāyapi nibbindati, kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati,
sn18.11:1.24: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn18.11:1.25: ‘khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī’ti.
